name: A Hero casts Sweeping Strikes in Cat Form, as its tooltip says (#11978)
contract: Sweeping Strikes 12328 reads "This ability is usable while shapeshifted." An AzerothCore spell correction added
SPELL_ATTR0_NOT_SHAPESHIFTED to it, and the spell has no spell family, so the Hero's Cat Form ignore-shapeshift
auras (9726361-9726364) never cover it: a Hero in Cat Form 768 was refused with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_SHAPESHIFT (68).
Expected: the cast succeeds, the Sweeping Strikes aura is applied and the Hero stays in Cat Form.

steps.label: The Hero is in Cat Form
Sweeping Strikes is not refused in Cat Form
the Sweeping Strikes aura is applied
and the Hero stays in Cat Form
